name: boxes_le_of_isHCParam
summary: boxes is the sum of the diagram weights over the |N|·|L| positions; each is at most β, read off the HC parameter at two positions.

steps.claim: boxes κ |L| = Σ_{(w, i)} diagramWeight(|L|, κ)(w, i) (FitsRanks.refl.sum_diagramWeight_eq_boxes) ≤ |N|·|L|·β (sum_le_card_nsmul), since each diagram weight λ(w, p) is at most β; and |e(w)| ≤ β. Both bounds come from the values of l_w at the positions p and |L| − 1 (h.exists_decrPosition_eq: l_w(i_p) = 2(e_w + λ(w, p)) + |L| − 1 − 2p) and |l| ≤ β (grind).
steps.lean:
(e w).natAbs ≤ β := by grw [← FitsRanks.refl.sum_diagramWeight_eq_boxes,
  sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ β] <;> simp <;> intro w <;> grind [h.exists_decrPosition_eq w
  (Nat.sub_one_lt (by simp)), h.exists_decrPosition_eq w, card_pos_iff, Ioo_eq_empty]
